description: This file contains unit tests and server implementations for Android binder thread state, involving HIDL and AIDL services, recursive call patterns, and thread-specific binder state checks.

classes.name: HidlServer
classes.description: Implementation of IHidlStuff interface, handling recursive HIDL calls between servers.

classes.name: AidlServer
classes.description: Implementation of Aidl interface, handling recursive AIDL calls between servers.

methods.name: callHidl
methods.description: Invokes a HIDL call to a service with specified id and index.

methods.name: callAidl
methods.description: Invokes an AIDL call to a service with specified id and index.

methods.name: getStackPointerDebugInfo
methods.description: Returns a string with current stack pointer info for debugging.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads output stream operator for BinderCallType enum.

methods.name: server
methods.description: Sets up AIDL and HIDL servers, starts thread pools, and runs the server loop.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes testing environment, forks server processes, and runs all tests.
